fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 28% match makes this a WEAK FIT for the Customer Success Manager role.

**Strengths:**
- One-to-one coaching and workshop facilitation, which are useful for customer advising
- Head of Year 9 role shows relationship building and cross-team coordination
- Python (pandas), Excel and Google Data Analytics study support usage-trend analysis

**Gaps:**
- No 5-7 years in a customer-facing commercial role
- No contract negotiation, pricing objection handling or up-selling experience
- No customer success methodology, renewal risk or MEDDIC training

**Recommendation:** Build commercial experience first through an entry-level customer success or onboarding role at a SaaS company, then reapply to Datadog.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Customer Success Managers have to make a complex product clear to customers and then keep those customers adopting it. I've spent 8 years in the classroom doing the same thing with physics: finding where understanding breaks down and fixing it. Over three years I raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86%.

The same habits apply to the work in your posting. As Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, I run weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, so building trust through regular, proactive contact is part of my week. I track progress in Excel and Google Sheets and present the results to senior leadership each term, which is the groundwork for monitoring usage trends and spotting where adoption is slipping. I also wrote a practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, a good match for the onboarding and advisory side of the role. I'm new to the sales cycle, and I'd value the MEDDIC and Command of the Message training you offer. I'm already building my data skills through basic Python and the Google Data Analytics Certificate, which is in progress.

Datadog's pitch is helping businesses manage complexity at scale, and I'd like to help your customers see that value in practice. I'm available to speak at your convenience and would welcome a conversation about the Boston team.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

After 8 years as a physics teacher, I'm moving into customer success, and the part I'm best at is what the role needs: running weekly parent calls, building trust with families and explaining complex things clearly. I've also trained 12 colleagues on a curriculum I wrote and tracked progress in spreadsheets to report results to senior leadership, which is the same habit of watching usage trends and acting on them. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday after 4pm UK time, and I can start a conversation about notice period whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
